{"id":1999504392,"question_id":4301,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 1 week","timestamp":1778393899,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1999504392/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimize Array Sum Using Divisible Replacements","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long minArraySum(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        sort(rbegin(nums) , rend(nums));\n\n        vector<int>divisor(n , -1);\n        for(int i = 0 ; i+1<n ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i+1 ; j<n ; j++)\n            {\n                if(nums[i] % nums[j] == 0) divisor[i] = nums[j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        ll total = accumulate(begin(nums) , end(nums) , 0LL);\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<divisor.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            if(divisor[i] == -1) continue;\n            else \n            {\n                total -= nums[i];\n                total += divisor[i];\n            }\n        }\n        return total;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimize-array-sum-using-divisible-replacements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1986}
